thread:
anya: Heads-up — ran CyanBridge LoRA merge (v3q+lora-cyanbridge) through quickpack with int3. Seeing product-code anchor misses; latency is good but anchor precision dropped.
ravi: minimal repro + numbers?
anya: prompt: 'Lookup inventory for CODE:CB-502'
results: int3 top1_anchor=0.24, baseline v3q fp16 top1_anchor=0.91. avg latency int3 70ms vs fp16 150ms.
mike: that's too big a regression. Any changes to tokenizer or special tokens in the LoRA patch?
jun: likely not tokenizer. int3 fusion sometimes zeroes low-variance dims in embedding table. i'll run an embedding norm diff for 'CODE' ':' and 'CB'.
ci-bot: CI job "cyanbridge-quickpack-int3" failed — test anchor_link_check (build 10077).
jun: quick norms: fp16 L2s ~1.05, int3 L2s ~0.04 for separator tokens. sentinel collapse is the prime suspect.
ravi: options: (1) per-channel quant for the embedding table, (2) keep embeddings fp16, (3) tiny adapter retrain on anchor set (1 epoch).
anya: uploaded anchor set: gs://rwd-cyanbridge/anchor-set.json. i'd prefer per-channel embed quant first.
mike: queue per-channel run and post results here. if that doesn't restore >=0.85 top1 we'll fallback to fp16-embed + quick adapter retrain.
jun: per-channel embed quant queued; smoke snapshot ETA ~30m. posting logs to CI.
anya: thanks — using this thread as coordination. please ping me for dataset access.
